title: Payoff Quotes, Payment in Full and Credit-Balance Refunds — Kestrel Advantage Balloon
content:
**1. Status for a quote.** A payoff quote on a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract can be issued only while the contract status is active, assigned for repossession, repossessed or deficiency, as the contract record shows.

**2. Good-through date.** The good-through date is the tier's quote validity days calendar days after the quote date unless the requester asks for an earlier date. *This clause is no longer in force for a customer payoff quote issued under the customer payoff quote rule, and is superseded by the current basis for that quote; every other payoff quote keeps it.*

**3. Per diem and payoff amount.** The per diem is the principal balance times the APR divided by the tier's day basis, rounded to the cent, and the payoff amount is the principal balance plus the fees due balance plus the per diem times the quote interest days. *This clause is no longer in force for a customer payoff quote issued under the customer payoff quote rule, and is superseded by the current basis for that quote; every other payoff quote keeps the per diem and payoff amount as the payoff formula computes them, by which the per diem is the principal balance times the APR divided by 100 divided by the day basis, rounded to the cent, and the payoff amount is the principal balance plus the fees due balance plus the per diem times the quote interest days.* The quote interest days are the calendar days from the day after the interest-paid-to date through the quote good-through date (or the redemption payment date), both inclusive.

**4. Paying in full.** Funds received on or before the good-through date in at least the quoted amount pay the contract in full; funds received later are applied as a payment and a new quote is needed.

**5. Third-party quotes.** A quote for a refinancing lender, a dealer trade-in or an insurance total loss is issued to that third party only with the customer's verified authorization on the call.

**6. Overpayment refunds.** An overpayment refund can be issued only when the contract status is paid in full or closed. A credit balance of at least the tier's automatic refund amount left after the balance reaches zero is refunded to the payer by check within the tier's refund days in calendar days; a smaller credit balance is refunded only on request.

**7. Kestrel Care cancellation refunds.** A cancellation refund from a financed Kestrel Care contract is credited to the principal balance and does not advance the next due date; when the contract is already paid in full or closed the refund is paid to the customer as an overpayment refund instead.

## Points of judgement

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Funds of at least the quoted amount received on the good-through date | Contract paid in full |
| Funds received the day after the good-through date | Applied as a payment; a new quote is needed |
| Credit balance at or above the automatic refund amount after payoff | Refunded by check without a request |
| Credit balance below that amount | Refunded only on request |

superseded_clauses: The good-through date is payoff_quote_valid_days calendar days after the quote date unless the requester asks for an earlier date.

The per diem is the principal_balance times apr divided by per_diem_day_basis, rounded to the cent, and the payoff amount is principal_balance plus fees_due_balance plus the per diem times balloon_msr_quote_interest_days.
